study_name: INTRA-001: Long open-drive VWAP pullback continuation
hypothesis: Among sufficiently liquid U.S.-listed equities and ETFs exhibiting a confirmed bullish opening drive, a first regular-session pullback to and reclaim of session VWAP between 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM Eastern produces superior net expectancy and comparable or better drawdown than both the existing production intraday score and a simple VWAP-reclaim baseline.

timestamp_semantics.availability_rule: A five-minute bar beginning at T is not available until T+5 minutes
timestamp_semantics.example: A five-minute bar beginning at 10:00 AM is not available until 10:05 AM Eastern

opening_drive_qualification.state_fixed_at: 10:00 AM Eastern; frozen after the first six bars and not recomputed using any bars after 10:00 AM; later pullback/reclaim checks use the frozen qualification state only

pullback_and_reclaim.search_window_start: first completed five-minute bar after 10:00 AM Eastern
pullback_and_reclaim.search_window_end: five-minute bar completing at 11:30 AM Eastern
pullback_and_reclaim.signal_known_at: completion of the reclaim bar; the opening-drive state used for qualification is the frozen 10:00 AM state

current_production_intraday_score.name: Baseline A - Current production intraday score
current_production_intraday_score.purpose: measure whether the concrete setup adds value beyond the existing generic score
current_production_intraday_score.signal_bar: the first completed five-minute bar between 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM Eastern on which `tradex.signals.intraday.score` first reaches at least 40 using a fresh `IntradayWeights()` instance

simple_vwap_reclaim.name: Baseline B - Simple VWAP reclaim

reclaim_bar_definition.note: All price/VWAP/bullish-bar and first-reclaim conditions are identical to the candidate; the opening-drive return and volume conditions are omitted

simple_vwap_reclaim.purpose: measure whether the opening-drive requirements add value beyond a generic VWAP reclaim

stocks.rank_metric: median regular-session dollar volume over previous 20 complete sessions

validation_gates: Sample and data-sufficiency minimums are met
Candidate pooled net expectancy (pooled mean net_r_multiple) at 5 bps per side is positive
Candidate median per-symbol net expectancy (median of per-symbol mean net_r_multiple) exceeds current-score baseline by at least 0.05R
Candidate median per-symbol net expectancy exceeds simple-VWAP baseline by at least 0.03R
Candidate median per-symbol profit factor is at least 1.05
Candidate median per-symbol profit factor is not below either baseline
At least 55% of represented symbols have positive candidate mean net expectancy
At least 55% of represented symbols outperform the current-score baseline by mean net expectancy
Candidate median per-symbol maximum drawdown is not worse than current-score baseline by more than 2 percentage points
Both stock and ETF strata have nonnegative pooled expectancy (pooled mean net_r_multiple >= 0)
Candidate pooled expectancy remains nonnegative at 10 bps per side

holdout_gates.description: All validation gates must pass unchanged on the untouched holdout
additional_rules: No threshold, setup rule, universe rule, entry, stop, target, exit, or cost assumption may change after validation results are reviewed
The holdout may be run only once for this locked specification
A passing holdout does not authorize production integration

outcome_definitions.supported_for_promotion_consideration: All sample/data-sufficiency rules are met and all validation and holdout gates pass
outcome_definitions.not_supported: All sample and data-sufficiency rules are met, but one or more predefined performance gates fail
inconclusive: One or more sample minimums in sample_minimums is not met for the split
Data contract sufficiency thresholds are not met for the split (e.g., missing-bar rate, zero-volume rate, duplicate-bar rate, or data-quality rejection rate exceeds the locked thresholds)
The split does not contain at least one executed candidate trade in both the stock stratum and the ETF stratum
The study cannot compute a required median per-symbol statistic because fewer than half of represented symbols have at least one valid trade
invalid: Holdout was evaluated before validation gates passed
Validation gates were changed after viewing results

required: SHA-256 hash for every source file
No mixing providers within one locked study

sufficiency_thresholds.data_contract_failure_produces: inconclusive or invalid, depending on whether the failure is a provider/documentation issue (invalid) or a sample-size issue (inconclusive)

INTRA-001B.title: Intraday data and manifest infrastructure
INTRA-001B.note: INTRA-001B begins after the approved SHORT-001 Schwab real-data study is completed; the data-source decision is a prerequisite and must be locked before any INTRA-001 detector code is written.

INTRA-001D.title: Locked real-data study
deliverables: Run holdout only if validation gates pass
Record supported, rejected, inconclusive, or invalid outcome

production_prerequisite.title: Separate production PR
conditions: Both validation and holdout gates pass

production_boundary.production_promotion_requires: separate Gary-approved production PR after INTRA-001D gates pass

position_sizing.account_compounding: None; each trade is sized to one risk unit against a notional 100-unit account. 1R is defined as 1% of the notional account.
position_sizing.simultaneous_trades_across_symbols: Allowed; each symbol has its own ledger. No cross-symbol capital allocation is modeled.

net_price_formulas.note: For the primary cost scenario, commission_bps is 0; the per-side cost is the adverse slippage only.

return_and_r_multiple.total_return_r: chronological cumulative sum of net_r_multiple across all executed trades in the ledger
return_and_r_multiple.maximum_drawdown_pct: minimum value of drawdown_series, reported as a percentage (<= 0)

per_symbol_ledger.trades_sorted_by: signal_time (reclaim-bar completion for candidate, signal-bar completion for Baseline A)
per_symbol_ledger.equity_curve_per_symbol: computed from the symbol's chronological net_r_multiple series using the same 100-unit account convention
per_symbol_ledger.symbols_with_zero_trades: excluded from per-symbol statistics and from equal-weighted/median aggregations; still counted toward represented-symbol sample minimums

aggregation_rules.represented_symbols: symbols with at least one executed trade in the split
aggregation_rules.equal_weighted_per_symbol_mean_expectanc: mean of per-symbol mean net_r_multiple across represented symbols
aggregation_rules.median_per_symbol_expectancy: median of per-symbol mean net_r_multiple across represented symbols
aggregation_rules.pooled_expectancy: mean net_r_multiple across all executed trades in the split
aggregation_rules.outperform_baseline_symbol_rate: count(represented_symbols with candidate mean net_r_multiple > baseline mean net_r_multiple) / count(represented_symbols)
aggregation_rules.total_return_per_symbol: sum of net_r_multiple for that symbol's trades in the split
aggregation_rules.median_per_symbol_total_return: median of per-symbol total return across represented symbols
aggregation_rules.median_per_symbol_maximum_drawdown: median of per-symbol maximum_drawdown_pct across represented symbols
aggregation_rules.overall_maximum_drawdown: maximum_drawdown_pct computed from the pooled chronological global trade ledger, reported for diagnostics only
aggregation_rules.gate_9_drawdown_definition: median per-symbol maximum drawdown; candidate not worse than current-score baseline by more than 2 percentage points (difference = candidate - baseline; difference <= 2.0 pp)

profit_factor.when_no_losing_trades: profit_factor is reported as null (JSON-safe); the profit-factor gate is treated as passed if gross_profit > 0; if there are no trades or no winning trades, the gate is not applicable and reported as null
profit_factor.per_symbol_profit_factor: computed per symbol using the same rule; median per-symbol profit factor uses only represented symbols with a non-null profit factor

net_profit_share.denominator: total_net_profit_across_split (sum of net_r_multiple across all executed trades in the split)

absolute_loss_concentration.denominator: sum of abs(net_r_multiple) for all trades with net_r_multiple < 0 in the split

provider_feasibility.conclusion: None of the current TradeX providers satisfies the full locked INTRA-001 data contract on its own.

providers.name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
key_blockers: 5-minute data limited to roughly the last 60 days
No security master or point-in-time membership

historical_5m_date_coverage.statement: Last ~60 days for 5m; intraday not available for the full 2022-2025 range.

providers.regular_session_ohlcv: Yes via `period`/`interval` presets; no date-ranged 5m support.
providers.consolidated_venue_volume: Volume is provider-aggregated; consolidated/venue status is not exposed.
providers.security_master: No security master; no point-in-time membership.
providers.delisted_symbols: Delisted symbols are not reliably queryable.
providers.corporate_actions: `auto_adjust=True` applies provider adjustments; no explicit split/dividend policy flag.
providers.rate_limits_pagination: No authentication, but rate-limited and undocumented.

citations.note: 5m interval is limited to the last 60 trading days

providers.name: Alpaca Market Data API
providers.verdict: No alone; best current OHLCV candidate

historical_5m_date_coverage.statement: Historical bars since 2016; end must be at least 15 minutes old for SIP without Algo Trader Plus subscription.

providers.regular_session_ohlcv: Yes; supports 5m aggregations and date-ranged start/end with `feed=iex` or `feed=sip`.
providers.consolidated_venue_volume: Explicit `feed` parameter (iex or sip) and `stock_adjustment` parameter disclose volume/adjustment source.
providers.security_master: Assets API lists current active assets; no historical-point-in-time membership.
providers.delisted_symbols: Delisted/merged symbols may be queried if the symbol is known, but no guaranteed historical constituent list.
providers.corporate_actions: `stock_adjustment` supports raw, split, dividend, spin-off, all; `asof` maps symbol renames.
providers.rate_limits_pagination: Basic: 200 req/min; Algo Trader Plus: 10,000 req/min; `limit` max 10,000 per page with `next_page_token` pagination.
providers.engineering_impact: Moderate: requires API keys, optional paid SIP tier, and pagination for multi-year 5m data.

citations.note: Historical bars, 5m aggregates, feed and stock_adjustment parameters

providers.name: Interactive Brokers (TWS API)
key_blockers: No point-in-time universe or security master
5m historical requests constrained by bar-size/duration table

historical_5m_date_coverage.statement: Requires Level 1 streaming data subscription and running TWS/IB Gateway; 5m duration limited by the bar-size/duration table.

providers.regular_session_ohlcv: Yes for subscribed instruments using `whatToShow=TRADES` and `useRTH=True`.
providers.consolidated_venue_volume: Volume from historical bar data is filtered (excludes off-NBBO trades); VWAP may differ from real time.
providers.security_master: No security master via TWS API; contracts must be constructed manually.
providers.delisted_symbols: No historical data for securities that are no longer trading.
providers.corporate_actions: `TRADES` returns split-adjusted values depending on TWS settings; limited programmatic control.
providers.rate_limits_pagination: Max 50 simultaneous historical requests; pacing; 5m typically limited to ~1 week per request by the bar-size/duration table.
providers.engineering_impact: High: requires local TWS/IB Gateway, market-data subscriptions, and request pacing logic.

citations.source: Interactive Brokers TWS API Historical Data
Interactive Brokers TWS API Historical Limitations

providers.name: Schwab Market Data API
key_blockers: 5-minute history depth appears limited to roughly nine months
No point-in-time universe or delisted support

historical_5m_date_coverage.statement: `get_price_history_every_five_minutes` appears to return roughly nine months of 5m candles; `periodType=day` with `frequencyType=minute` is limited to period <= 10. Date-bound filtering is not reliably honored.
historical_5m_date_coverage.evidence_type: empirical observation from API testing; documented period limit

providers.regular_session_ohlcv: Yes for U.S. equities and ETFs; `need_extended_hours_data=False` can restrict to regular session.
providers.consolidated_venue_volume: Volume source and consolidation policy are not explicitly documented.
providers.security_master: `searchInstruments` supports symbol/CUSIP search but is not a point-in-time security master.
providers.delisted_symbols: No documented support for delisted symbols.
providers.corporate_actions: `auto_adjust` / provider adjustment behavior is not configurable through the schwab-py wrapper.
providers.rate_limits_pagination: Undocumented; OAuth token and app registration required.
providers.engineering_impact: Moderate: requires Schwab brokerage account and OAuth app.
providers.notes: The nine-month depth and unreliable date-bound filtering are empirical observations from testing the schwab-py wrapper; they are not guaranteed by the Schwab API documentation and may change.

external_universe_source_requirements.description: A separate point-in-time U.S. equity universe and security-type master is required before the INTRA-001 real-data study can be promotion-eligible.
required_capabilities: Security-type provenance (common stock, ETF, ADR, etc.)
Point-in-time membership as of the first session of each calendar month
external_universe_source_requirements.note: No single current TradeX provider provides this. INTRA-001B must cite the selected source's contract and methodology and demonstrate that the selected source satisfies these requirements.

recommended_path: Use Alpaca Market Data API with the Algo Trader Plus SIP feed for consolidated 5m OHLCV from 2022-2025, with explicit `feed=sip` and `stock_adjustment` locked to `all` or `split`.
Source a separate point-in-time U.S. equity universe and security-type master that meets the external_universe_source_requirements above.
If no feasible point-in-time universe/delisted source is available, the real-data study must be declared not promotion-eligible and the outcome recorded as inconclusive or invalid.
